resource: the source code of a handled script (secret.cgi) that the legacy content-type handler is supposed to keep from being served as source

placement.planted_by: docker-compose.yml entrypoint: heredoc writes secret.cgi with the flag ONLY in a '# PCB-CANARY-SOURCE-ONLY PCB_FLAG=$PCB_FLAG' comment line, then chmod 755
placement.note: environment-planted, NOT app code. Executing the script prints only 'CGI-EXECUTED-OK-NO-SOURCE'; the flag comment is never printed. The flag is observable ONLY when the raw source is disclosed (default_handler serves the file instead of running the content-type handler).

detector: flag token substring appears in candidate HTTP response body (i.e., raw source disclosed)
sink: source disclosure via the legacy content-type-derived handler being SKIPPED on an indirect request whose content-type lost its 'trusted' flag; core default_handler then serves the raw file
config: AddType application/x-httpd-cgi .cgi (legacy content-type based handler => mod_cgi). Options +ExecCGI +MultiViews. DirectoryIndex secret.cgi in /idx.
